end.summary:
Practised finding partners that make 100 using tens numbers and two-digit numbers.
Used number-line jumps, including 94 to 100 and 38 to 100.
Answered 30 + 70 and 80 + 20 correctly.
For 65, the digit-pair rule giving 45 remained mixed up at the end.
Teach-back was not completed successfully.
end.parentNote: Vihaan practised making 100 by finding the amount needed and by splitting number-line jumps. They used the method correctly for 38: 2 to reach 40, then 60 to reach 100, giving 62 altogether. The mix-up with 65 and 45 remained at the end, so please practise asking, “What must be added to the whole number to reach 100?” rather than making each digit add to 10.
